subject: planner: fix index range intersection for in-list and other predicates (#58029)
summary: Change is fix-control (Fix54337) gated and only updates planner range detaching: when an IN-list-derived point-range result exists but the best CNF-item range result has strictly more AccessConds that subsume the IN-list AccessConds, it replaces the point ranges with the CNF intersection ranges and removes the newly-detached AccessConds from remained filters. Added casetest coverage for IN-list + additional predicate intersections, including empty-intersection -> TableDual.
